items.problem: UWP Application.Suspending/Resuming carried into App.xaml.cs fails to compile in WinUI 3 (CS1061), and the lifecycle pattern anchor offered no replacement.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 16 'App.xaml.cs(29,18): error CS1061 ... Suspending'; turn 17 Get-MigrationPattern -Anchor lifecycle returned activation-only guidance; skill-defects.json item 1.
items.root_cause: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application has no Suspending/Resuming events (desktop apps are not OS-suspended); the skill never stated this nor gave the Window.Closed save-on-exit replacement.
items.change: Added an 'adaptable' entry to unsupported-api-inventory.json matching \.Suspending\b|SuspendingEventArgs|SuspendingOperation|\.Resuming\b -> anchor 'lifecycle', so Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 injects an inline TODO[migrate-NNN]: see PATTERNS.md#lifecycle above the Suspending wiring before the agent builds.
items.expected_effect: Agent is routed to the lifecycle pattern at bootstrap time and replaces Suspending with window.Closed instead of hitting a build error.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, App.xaml.cs carries a TODO[migrate-...]#lifecycle on the Suspending line and the build no longer emits CS1061 on 'Suspending'.

items.problem: The lifecycle pattern anchor the TODO routes to had no suspend/resume content to answer the question.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#lifecycle pre-edit covered only OnLaunched/OnActivated/AppInstance; turn 17 fetch did not resolve the Suspending error.
items.root_cause: Missing documentation of the suspend/resume -> Window.Closed mapping.
items.change: Added a 'Suspend / resume have no equivalent' subsection to the lifecycle anchor: Suspending/Resuming + SuspendingEventArgs/SuspendingOperation are gone; save on window.Closed, keep restore in OnLaunched, delete the OnSuspending handler. Required so the Tier-1 TODO anchor actually answers the question.
items.expected_effect: Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor lifecycle now returns the concrete save-on-close replacement.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, the agent resolves the Suspending TODO using window.Closed without external research, and SuspensionManager state-save still works (smoke launch stays alive).
